project.title: Activated sludge metagenome
project.description: 16S rRNA metagenomic analysis was applied to the ready biodegradability test in order to ascertain the relationships between the biodegradability of the test substances and the microbiota in activated sludge.
project.center_name: Environmental Health Science Laboratory, Sumitomo Chemical Co., Ltd.
